_description: Daily (365-day) model settings and design candidates for run_candidates.py. The brine chain (producer, separator, filters, HEX, injector) comes from doublet_challenge.json and is run in GEMINI; everything downstream is the setpoint energy-balance model in daily_model.py.

_provenance.esp_options.*.flow_scale: ASSUMED pump size: HC27000 curve stretched along the flow axis (flow x s, power x s, efficiency shape unchanged). s = 1.0 is the GEMINI example pump.
_provenance.esp_options.s1.8.no_stages: ASSUMED 24 stages: reaches 300 m3/h at ~63 Hz (332 m3/h at 70 Hz); 20 stages would need ~69 Hz.
_provenance.esp_options.s1.0.no_stages: GEMINI example (10 stages); max ~176 m3/h at 70 Hz.
_provenance.heat_pump.eta_lorenz / cop_cap: ASSUMED Lorenz efficiency 0.45 with COP cap 6.0 (base case); sink out 100 C (OFFICIAL supply). Sensitivity: eta 0.5, no cap (GEMINI HeatpumpBasic default).
_provenance.heat_pump.mode / COP_0: GEMINI HeatpumpBasic defaults (COP_0 only used by its own optimizer in the cross-check).
_provenance.absorption_chiller.min_drive_inlet_C: ASSUMED 75 C, single-effect LiBr; the chiller sits at the hot end of the brine (after filter_a, before the HEX).
_provenance.absorption_chiller.min_drive_outlet_C: ASSUMED 70 C drive-water outlet (typical single-effect hot-water glide ~80/70 C); limits how much drive heat the brine can give.
_provenance.chp: Produced gas goes to the GEMINI CHP model first (efficiency 0.8 from doublet_challenge.json, fixed 1/3 electric, 2/3 heat); its heat feeds the 100 C top-up stage, so the heat pump only covers the lift CHP heat cannot. Remaining produced gas -> boiler; flared only if its heat cannot be used.
_provenance.electricity_export_credit: ASSUMED none: CHP electricity offsets plant load; any export earns no emission credit.
_provenance.ranking.extra_doublet_min_improvement: User decision: an extra doublet is accepted only if it improves external gas or emissions by >= 5%.
_provenance.ranking.depth_step_m / depth_step_min_im: User decision: depth explored in 250 m steps from 2500 m; a deeper step is accepted only if emissions improve by >= 5% vs the previous accepted depth.
_provenance.ranking.max_depth_m: ASSUMED 4000 m upper bound on extrapolating the official 2500 m reservoir data (gradient T, hydrostatic P).
_provenance.esp_placement.min_intake_bar: ASSUMED 30 bar ESP intake pressure at the flow cap (gas-handling limit for GLR 0.8 brine; free gas at the intake is not modelled). The ESP setting depth is a design variable: the shallowest depth (rounded up to depth_step_m) meeting it. Hard engineering check.
_provenance.esp_placement.min_clearance_above_reserv: ASSUMED: the pump must sit at least 100 m above the reservoir midpoint.
_provenance.well_checks.max_tubing_velocity_m_s: ASSUMED 4 m/s erosion/vibration guideline in the 0.178 m (7-inch) production/injection tubing, checked at the maximum flow. Hard engineering check.
_provenance.cooling_supply_return_C: 20 C OFFICIAL supply / 26 C ASSUMED return; the energy balance uses the MW demand directly.
_provenance.external_gas.emission_factor_kg_per_GJ: ASSUMED 56.6 kg CO2/GJ pipeline natural gas (GEMINI example value).
_provenance.external_gas.lhv_MJ_per_Nm3: ASSUMED 35.8 MJ/Nm3 (methane LHV), only used to report Nm3.
_provenance.produced_gas_not_burned: ASSUMED flared: its CO2 (combustion + 20% pass-through) is emitted whether it is burned in CHP/boiler or flared.
_provenance.dispatch.summer_window: ASSUMED May-September; maintenance windows are placed in the lowest heat + cooling-drive need (H + C/COP_abs) inside it.
_provenance.dispatch.maintenance_days_per_doublet: 330-day rule = geothermal source availability, demand met all 365 days (organizer clarification, Discord, 2026-11-01): 35 consecutive days per doublet, non-overlapping; with 1 doublet the backup covers them.
_provenance.gas_handling.options: Agent design variable. chp: all produced gas to CHP (then boiler, flare); co2_reinject: separate the CO2 (20 mol%, OFFICIAL) and reinject it with the brine, CH4 to CHP; reinject_all: reinject all produced gas with the brine, no combustion (no CHP heat or electricity). Dissolution of the reinjected gas is checked (gas_dissolution, see below).
_provenance.gas_dissolution: DERIVED check (gas_solubility.py): bubble point of the brine holding the reinjected gas (co2_reinject: 0.16 Nm3 CO2/m3; reinject_all: 0.8 Nm3/m3, 80/20 CH4/CO2) vs the lowest injector wellhead pressure of the year (hottest injection T) and vs reservoir P/T. Henry constants IAPWS G7-04 (Fernandez-Prini et al. 2003) with Poynting correction (v_inf 35/37 cm3/mol, ASSUMED); salting-out Weisenberger & Schumpe (1996); gas phase Peng-Robinson, k_ij 0.09 (ASSUMED); salinity DERIVED from 1030 kg/m3 (NaCl at 20 C: 0.80 mol/kg; conservative reading at reservoir T: ~2.1-2.3 mol/kg, used for the check). Hard check: margin >= 1 at reservoir conditions and the dip-tube depth (where P_wh + rho g z reaches the bubble point) above the reservoir. Validated within ~10% of Duan & Sun (2003) for CO2; conservative for CH4.
_provenance.gas_handling.co2_reinject emission facto: DERIVED: only CH4 combustion CO2 counts: 68.6 kg/GJ x x_CH4 / (x_CH4 + x_CO2) = 68.6 x 0.8 = 54.9 kg CO2/GJ (the 0.2 Nm3 pass-through CO2 per Nm3 gas is reinjected).
_provenance.gas_handling.separation_compression_kWh_: ASSUMED 0.1 kWh per kg CO2 for separation + compression to injection pressure (order of magnitude for membrane/amine separation plus multistage compression; not modelled in detail). 0.2 Nm3 CO2/Nm3 gas x 1.9635 kg/Nm3 = 0.393 kg CO2 per Nm3 gas (DERIVED).
_provenance.gas_handling.reinjection_compression_kWh: DERIVED 0.197 kWh per kg of produced gas (0.9653 kg/Nm3; user decision 2026-11-04): isothermal ideal-gas compression at 40 C from 1 atm to the 61.5 bar(g) bubble point that the gas_dissolution check finds at the injector wellhead of n2 at 3500 m, divided by an ASSUMED 0.7 compressor efficiency. Was ASSUMED 0.1. co2_reinject keeps the ASSUMED 0.1 kWh/kg CO2 (conservative: its DERIVED minimum to the ~5 bar(g) wellhead is ~0.04 kWh/kg).
_provenance.sensitivities: ASSUMED what-if cases for the C1-C3 comparison (run_candidates.py): HP_eta0.5_nocap = Lorenz efficiency 0.5 with no COP cap. The one-at-a-time sensitivity of the final design is in sensitivity.py.
_provenance.n_minus_1: ASSUMED resilience case: UNPLANNED outage of one doublet on the peak heating day and the peak cooling day (in addition to any planned maintenance). Installed backup (boiler, electric chiller) = max(annual peak duty, N-1 duty).
_provenance.dispatch.heating_tolerance_K: ASSUMED: geothermal (HEX + heat pump) counts as meeting heating when within 0.05 K of 100 C.
